title: What Launch Week Really Changed
question: What did GTA VI's launch week actually change for you as a player?
angle: Open close to: "GTA File, part 1. Launch week changed how you own GTA, not just what you play." Code-in-box copies hold a download code, not a disc; the game needed up to 212 GB before it would start; and it unlocked at midnight local time, so New Zealand played first. Say what that means for you: storage, your internet, and spoilers from earlier time zones. Dollars-first audience, US times first. Say only what the sources say and name them.
facts: GTA VI released on Thursday November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (Rockstar Support).
It unlocked at midnight local time in every region, with New Zealand first at 11:00 UTC on November 18 (Rockstar Support).
Pre-loading opened on November 10 (PS5 at midnight local, Xbox at 00:00 GMT) and the game needs up to 212 GB depending on device (Rockstar Newswire).
Code-in-box versions hold a download code, not a disc; boxed copies were in retailers from November 12 (Rockstar Newswire).

title: The Map Is Hiding More Than You Think
question: How big is GTA VI's map really, and what does Rockstar say is in it?
angle: Open close to: "GTA File, part 2. Rockstar never gave the map a number. It gave a comparison." Game Informer's cover story puts Leonida at about twice GTA V's map; credit that figure to the cover story as the sources report it, never to one named person. Aaron Garbut's own words are that it is Rockstar's largest map by some degree, denser, with a lot more interiors; Rupert Humphries said the story will not take you everywhere. recap: Part 1 covered how launch week changed owning the game: a download code in the box, up to 212 GB, and a midnight unlock that started in New Zealand.
facts: Game Informer's cover story (issue 382, September 29) reports Leonida is about twice the size of GTA V's map, as TechRadar and Dexerto relay it.
Rockstar's Aaron Garbut called it Rockstar's largest map by some degree, denser and more detailed, with a lot more interiors (Game Informer, via TechRadar).
Rockstar released an official printable cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download on November 19 (Rockstar Newswire).
Rockstar has not given an official area figure for the map.

facts: GTA VI's first six radio stations have celebrity hosts, there are on-demand podcasts, and radio can be played on foot through the phone's headphones (Rockstar Newswire).
GTA VI: The Album released on November 19 from Atlantic Records with 34 tracks (Rockstar Newswire).
The launch trailer, released October 15, is set to "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard (Rockstar Newswire).

facts: PlayStation's GTA VI page lists PS5 Pro Enhanced, DualSense haptic feedback and Tempest 3D Audio.
